g.text: Final-letter scoring alone conceals control failures
Paired diagnostic: same 27 graphs × 30 counts per model; opened panel, not confirmation.
Historical models differ in memory, objectives, data and capacity. Isolated arms share an identical executor.
Cohorts contain only sampled counts; right panel shows measured points without interpolation.
